rows.details: ICAR-Central Institute for Research on Cotton Technology (ICAR-CIRCOT)
Application Last Date: 25.10.2026 (05:30 pm) | Interview Date: 28.10.2026

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The institute has notified a total of 3 vacancies distributed across sections:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the specific educational and age criteria laid down for each specialization under the Young Professional-I category. The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 45 years. Upper age relaxations are applicable as per Government of India rules: 3 years for OBC candidates, 5 years for SC/ST candidates, and 10 years for PH candidates.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduates with at least 60% marks in Computer Application/Information Technology/Computer Science/Artificial Intelligence/Operating Systems/Software Engineering/Computer Graphics.
rows.desirable: Knowledge of IT applications, virtual meeting platforms and computer skills (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

rows.essential_qualification: B.Com/BBA/BBS (With minimum 60% marks) from a recognized University/College, with minimum 1 year of experience in relevant field.
rows.desirable: Knowledge of final accounts, auditing, taxation, drafting of letters/notes, and Tally.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 30,000/- per month. The appointment is purely temporary and contractual, co-terminus with the project. The initial engagement is for one year, and it is extendable for two more years (one year at a time) subject to organizational requirements and the candidate's satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-CIRCOT Young Professional-I
content_sections.text: Download the application format provided in the official notification PDF. Fill out the application form completely and attach self-attested copies of certificates for age, qualifications, experience, and NOC (if employed). Combine the application and all relevant documents into a single PDF file. Send the single PDF file via email to [email protected] on or before 25 October 2026 by 05:30 PM. Bring all original documents at the time of the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a walk-in interview conducted in hybrid mode. The reporting date and time for the interview is 28 October 2026 at 10:00 AM, with the interview starting at 11:00 AM at ICAR-CIRCOT, Adenwala Road, Five Gardens, Matunga, Mumbai 400019.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Young Professional-I post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary, contractual, and co-terminus with the project or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q2. What is the maximum duration of engagement for YP-I?
faq.answer: The engagement is initially for one year and is extendable for two more years (one year at a time) up to a maximum duration of three years.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age relaxations?
faq.answer: Relaxations are admissible as per GOI rules: 3 years for OBC candidates, 5 years for SC/ST candidates, and 10 years for PH candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the deadline for submitting applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email by 25 October 2026 up to 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What documents are required at the time of the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents along with a No Objection Certificate (NOC) if currently employed elsewhere.
